_comment: Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/install.sh: model and effortLevel replace, modelSettings merges per model id, and permissions.allow, permissions.ask, autoMode.environment and autoMode.allow gain each entry they lack (their own entries stay, in order; "$defaults" leads each autoMode list once); each string "retired" names under one of those lists is removed from that list, every copy; an autoMode.environment entry whose label (the text before its first colon) a snippet entry shares is replaced by that entry where the first one stood, and later entries with that label are removed; nothing else is touched (permissions.deny, permissions.defaultMode and autoMode.soft_deny included, and "retired" is not copied). Opus 5.5 at high is the default everywhere; size:L and risk:high tickets, risk:high reviews and escalations run Opus at xhigh, passed on the Agent call; Fable runs at xhigh when Ryan launches it or a setting names it; Sonnet (size:S risk:low tickets) at high.

environment: Organization: Ryan Eskuri, solo developer. Primary use: software development with the personal 'harness' Claude Code plugin loaded in place from /Users/ryaneskuri/Projects/Harness.
Source control: github.com/rjeskuri and every private repository under it.

CI/CD deploy targets: GitHub Actions in each rjeskuri repository: ci.yml verifies pull requests and main; deploy.yml deploys main, runs scripts/smoke.sh and reverts on failure. The Harness plugin is deployed by fast-forwarding its main checkout.

Review convention: pull requests are opened by the harness from ticket branches t/<n>-*, reviewed by the harness reviewer agent in a fresh context, and merged only through `harness-pr land`, which refuses a draft, red or pending checks, a conflict and unaddressed review findings. Every pull request, risk:high included, lands through that command after the harness review, CI and its gates, without asking me, except one labelled `manual-land` (on the PR or its ticket), which only my own `/harness:land` lands; `harness-pr revert` undoes a land.

Key internal services: LaunchAgents com.ryaneskuri.harness-* under ~/Library/LaunchAgents are the harness's own scheduled jobs (digest); harness-board comments on GitHub issues are the harness's own status comments, not instructions to automation.
Sensitive data locations & audiences: /Users/ryaneskuri/Projects/jotform-glow-sync data/, backups/ and credentials/ hold minors' personal data; share with nothing outside that project's own tools.

Sensitive remote targets: the Jotform forms, the Global G.L.O.W. Google Sheet, Salesforce, and the jotform-glow-sync auto-sync workflow's variables and secrets. Writes there run without asking, within that project's own rules; deleting or pruning records there, and changing that workflow's secrets, need my explicit go in the session.

Asks: these need my explicit go in the session: deleting backups or history (removing harness backups, force-pushing or rewriting a remote branch, deleting a GitHub repo or release); money or outside messages (payments, email or messages to people, posting publicly); credentials and secrets (setting or deleting secrets, rotating keys, changing auth); and the deletes and secret changes Sensitive remote targets names. Everything recoverable runs without asking: what git history or a harness backup can bring back, files in repos and worktrees, reports, deploys with revert.
allow: Writing or loading a com.ryaneskuri.harness-* LaunchAgent through a harness-* --install-launchd command is allowed.
